# KB

- Read `REPO-ROOT/.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Read `REPO-ROOT/.github/KnowledgeBase/Index.md`.
- Use `REPO-ROOT/.github/TaskLogs/Copilot_KB.md` as the working artifact.

## Goal and Constraints

- Your goal is to update the repository knowledge base.
- Prefer small, durable guidance over chat-style notes.
- Keep repo-specific stable knowledge in `.github/KnowledgeBase/`.

## Output Requirement

- update `Copilot_KB.md` with the requested KB task
- update `.github/KnowledgeBase/Index.md` or linked durable docs when needed
- avoid duplicating transient execution chatter
- if the request contains no explicit phase block, continue the current KB task
